title: Daily Private Sessions
summary: One-to-one STEM lessons, on your timetable.
imageAlt: A Projekt Inspire facilitator guiding a practical learning activity
details: Choose your own topics and learn one-to-one with a facilitator.
Sessions include a 30-minute break. Working hours are 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

title: Saturday Sessions
summary: Explore, build, and discover together every Saturday.
imageAlt: Children building a model together during a practical STEM activity
details: Book one Saturday workshop at a time, from 10:00 a.m.–12:30 p.m.
A 30-minute break is included. Institutional partnerships are available on request.

title: Holiday Camps
summary: Hands-on holiday adventures, morning or afternoon.
imageAlt: Students collaborating on a hands-on engineering project
details: Holiday, mid-term and end-of-year camps follow NECTA and Cambridge school calendars.
Camps run Monday–Friday for up to four weeks, depending on the holiday.
Morning and afternoon shifts are booked independently. Each lasts 2½ hours, including a 30-minute break.
Institutional partnerships are available on request.

title: On-Site STEM Clubs
summary: Weekly hands-on STEM learning at your school.
imageAlt: Students working together on a laptop during a school STEM session
details: Weekly club meetings take place at your school during school hours, under a partnership agreement.
One-hour sessions are available for lower primary, upper primary and secondary students.

title: STEM Park Visits
summary: Explore hands-on STEM in Dar es Salaam or Tanga.
imageAlt: Projekt Inspire educators demonstrating a practical science experiment
details: Hands-on activities at our Dar es Salaam and Tanga STEM Parks welcome children, families, groups and adults.
Visits include a 30-minute break and fit within working hours, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

title: STEM-Themed Events
summary: Bring STEM fun to birthdays, school fairs, and team days.
imageAlt: A child enjoying a hands-on experiment at a STEM birthday experience
details: Add interactive STEM activities to birthdays, family days, school fairs, competitions and team-building events.
A three-hour experience for all ages. We also partner with institutions to host events on their premises.

title: Annual STEM Youth Bootcamp
summary: Build projects, develop skills, and learn from expert mentors.
imageAlt: Young people taking part in a collaborative Projekt Inspire workshop
details: For O-Level, A-Level, college and university learners.
Explore innovation, technology, leadership and entrepreneurship through coding, robotics, engineering and digital tools.
Develop career readiness and problem-solving skills, with mentorship from industry experts, university lecturers and young innovators.
Build projects and pitch ideas at the final showcase. Certificates, awards and internship or mentorship opportunities are available for outstanding participants.
